title: SSC CGL Geography
summary: SSC CGL Tier I Geography past questions from 108 shifts, 2023 to 2025, five a day. Questions SSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 113 Tier I shifts, 2023 to 2025, including questions SSC reprinted word for word. SSC rarely reprints a General Awareness question but asks the same fact again in new words: those are the repeats, and a fact list it keeps drawing on (the Article for a provision, the author of a work) is a type. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_SSC_GK.md) and checked in the main session. Questions marked defective are left out.
